description:
Homeowner diagnostics with real numbers: well water, hard water, softeners, water heaters, and the rest of the systems in your house.

Most of the advice on these problems was written by a company that sells the equipment. This channel takes the homeowner's side instead.

Every video works one symptom back to its cause, names the cheap test that confirms it, gives real prices and real thresholds, and says plainly when the honest answer is to stop and call a licensed pro. No vague "it depends" — figures you can act on.

Start here if your water smells, tastes odd, stains fixtures, leaves scale, or your softener is burning through salt.

New long-form video every week, with shorter clips through the week.

General information only, not a substitute for a certified lab test, a licensed plumber, or a licensed well contractor. Test your own water before spending money on treatment, and take health questions to your county health department.
